title: DrABC neural network predicts germline pathogenic variant carrier status in breast cancer
summary: In 3041 breast cancer patients from seven hospitals tested for 50 cancer predisposition genes, 332 (11.3%) carried pathogenic variants. The hierarchical neural network DrABC predicted BRCA1/2 carrier status with AUC 0.79 (95% CI 0.74-0.85) in an independent multicenter cohort, versus 0.57-0.70 for BRCAPRO, BOADICEA, Myriad, PENN II and NCCN criteria. It reached AUC 0.74 for any predisposition gene. The study is retrospective and the abstract does not state the validation size.
ai_technology: DrABC, a hierarchical neural network on phenotype data
organization: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Wenzhou Medical University; Cancer Hospital of Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

evidence.tested: Validation in an independent multicenter cohort, compared with existing risk models and NCCN criteria.
evidence.unknown: Validation cohort size and performance in other populations; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts carrier status from age at diagnosis, cancer and family history, and pathology.
